title: Shuffle Test
summary: Sector review: is the rise in women among first-time flyers bigger than chance? Answer with a permutation test you build yourself.
hints: Inside `replicate(5000, { ... })`: shuffle with `e <- sample(era)`, then return the same difference computed with `e` instead of `era`.
`p_shuffle <- mean(abs(shuffled) >= abs(observed))` (two-sided). Then `decision <- if (p_shuffle < 0.05) "reject" else "fail to reject"`.
